integrity: The all-dimensional statements are proved algebraically; independently computed finite cases are corroboration rather than substitutes for proof.
scientific_limitations: Only characteristic two and cubic exterior elements with nonzero degree-one wedge annihilator are classified for general dimension.
The six-dimensional binary trivector orbit counts were already covered by earlier orbit literature and are included only as an independently reproduced check.
No comprehensive theorem for cubics without linear wedge annihilator in dimensions at least seven is claimed.
The geometry concerns the reduced algebraic locus, not its possible scheme-theoretic multiplicities.
Novelty is a same-model literature assessment, not independent historical-priority certification.
title: The annihilator-line strata of cubic exterior multipliers in characteristic two
